decision: Patch rustix to 1.1.6 and refresh the canonical test target inventory.
reason: RUSTSEC-2026-0486 blocks the release. Cargo already discovered example:fragment_prefix_proof on public main, but the frozen target inventory omitted it.
verification: The generated target inventory adds the existing example and preserves all 3,708 test rows. The known-failure inventory remains empty and binds to the regenerated manifest. The only changed crate version is rustix. Rebuild all ten release binaries and run GitHub CI and Security.
not_tested: No new native desktop acceptance is inferred.
